text.3:120: If a lucky chance befall you, it is evil unto them, and if disaster strike you they rejoice thereat. But if ye persevere and keep from evil their guile will never harm you. Lo! Allah is Surrounding what they do.
text.4:76: Those who believe do battle for the cause of Allah; and those who disbelieve do battle for the cause of idols. So fight the minions of the devil. Lo! the devil's strategy is ever weak.
text.7:183: I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme is strong.
text.8:18: That (is the case); and (know) that Allah (it is) Who maketh weak the plan of disbelievers.
text.12:5: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.
text.12:28: So when he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said: Lo! this is of the guile of you women. Lo! the guile of you is very great.
text.12:33: He said: O my Lord! Prison is more dear than that unto which they urge me, and if Thou fend not off their wiles from me I shall incline unto them and become of the foolish.
text.12:34: So his Lord heard his prayer and fended off their wiles from him. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.
text.12:50: And the king said: Bring him unto me. And when the messenger came unto him, he (Joseph) said: Return unto thy lord and ask him what was the case of the women who cut their hands. Lo! my Lord knoweth their guile.
text.12:52: (Then Joseph said: I asked for) this, that he (my lord) may know that I betrayed him not in secret, and that surely Allah guideth not the snare of the betrayers.
text.20:60: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).
text.20:64: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.
text.20:69: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.
text.21:70: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
text.22:15: Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth!.
text.37:98: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
text.40:25: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error.
text.40:37: The roads of the heavens, and may look upon the god of Moses, though verily I think him a liar. Thus was the evil that he did made fairseeming unto Pharaoh, and he was debarred from the (right) way. The plot of Pharaoh ended but in ruin.
text.52:42: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
text.52:46: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
text.68:45: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
text.77:39: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
text.86:15: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
text.86:16: And I plot a plot (against them).
text.105:2: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
